items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Well, I came to New York actually in the beginning to join Fletcher.

ctx.x: Then you left to come to New York with -- who'd you come to New York with? Don Redman or who?

Well, I came to New York actually in the beginning to join Fletcher. Now Fletcher wanted me to play violin. He wanted me to play trombone. He wanted me to sing and then double just playing [rhythmic] piano, you know, because I knew the piano, for $100 a week.
